question: Fill in the blank (3) with the appropriate word from the options below:
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**infectious**" refers to diseases caused by pathogenic microorganisms, such as bacteria, viruses, parasites, or fungi, that can be spread directly or indirectly from one person to another. (संक्रामक)
 
• However in this context, we are talking about diseases which are persistent and long-lasting (chronic diseases).
 
• The other options: "**unmedical**," "**indemnified**," and "**lifestyle**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is ''**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Such a diet not only provides the necessary nutrients for optimal growth and overall well-being but also reduces the risk of infectious__ conditions such as heart disease and diabetes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Unmedical (अचिकित्सीय)**: not related to or involving medical practice.
 
• **Indemnified (क्षतिपूर्ति)**: provide security or protection against a loss or other financial burden.
 
• **Lifestyle (जीवन शैली)**: the way in which a person or group lives.
